title: Cannonball House

services.name: Our Exhibits
services.desc: Stepping into the home, visitors are transported to the mid-19th century, immediately noticing the twelve-foot ceilings and period-appropriate furnishings. The foyer features reproduction 1850s wallpaper and a towering 36-inch pier mirror that stretches from floor to ceiling. A leaning grandfather clock stands beside an 1850s rosewood square grand piano, while matching rugs accent the heart-pine floors. The landscapes and portraits displayed in this room are all the work of Miss Lizzie Canning, daughter of the home’s second owner, Charles Canning.
